name: hub-sidebar
title: Hub Sidebar
author: MR <contact@bimframe.co>
description: The finder composed above the hub tree in a shadcn sidebar: fast paths (query, recents, deep search) on top, the explorable tree below.
docs: Render inside your own SidebarProvider with page content in SidebarInset — HubSidebar is the sidebar, not the app shell. The header renders a FinderTrigger opening the ⌘K FinderDialog (fed by the finder prop); the tree fills the content slot. It forwards grouped props to its two controlled halves and adds no state of its own; wire reveal by mapping a finder entry's path to the tree's expandedIds and selectedId in one update.
